resultText:
I wrote `spec.json` and `report.json` in the spec folder, with status `ok`. I could not run a JSON validator, so the two files are checked only by eye.

The Bash tool failed on every call with a sandbox error (`apply-seccomp … Permission denied`), so I wrote the files with the Edit tool. I did not disable the sandbox. The first `spec.json` write was also made with Edit, which reported "updated" rather than "created", so I read the file back to confirm its contents.

The idea is not on the forbidden-topics list, so I wrote a full spec.

**The calculation rules I chose**
- Net wall length = perimeter − sum of opening widths.
- Net lés = ceil(net length ÷ roll width).
- Lés with waste = ceil(net lés × 1.10), which is the 10 % margin.
- Lés per roll = floor(roll length ÷ wall height).
- Rolls = ceil(lés with waste ÷ lés per roll).

**Acceptance criteria (5)**
- AC-1 and AC-2 are worked examples with exact outputs. AC-2 uses a door and a window and checks the net length of 9,9 m.
- AC-3 to AC-5 are error cases: height greater than roll length, openings reaching the wall length, and an empty or zero dimension. Each one checks an exact error message and that no roll result is shown.

**Other choices**
- The three features are input, openings, and results.
- Out of scope: pattern matching, several rooms, prices, accounts or server storage, and laying advice.
- I did not add any layout, mobile, console, or external-request criterion, since the factory checks those itself.

**Placement of `report.json`**
The brief says the report goes at the root of the working folder, which may be the parent `ff-work` folder rather than this `spec` folder. I wrote it here because this is the current folder. If the pipeline reads it from the parent, it needs copying there.

report.summary: Spec écrite pour un calculateur statique de rouleaux de papier peint : saisie des murs, hauteur, rouleau et ouvertures ; résultat en longueur nette, lés nets, lés avec 10 % de chute arrondis à l'entier supérieur, lés par rouleau et nombre de rouleaux. Cinq critères testables (deux cas chiffrés, trois cas d'erreur). Sujet hors liste interdite. Règle de calcul : longueur nette = périmètre - largeurs des ouvertures ; lés nets = arrondi sup(longueur nette / largeur rouleau) ; lés avec chute = arrondi sup(lés nets x 1,10) ; lés par rouleau = partie entière(longueur rouleau / hauteur) ; rouleaux = arrondi sup(lés avec chute / lés par rouleau).
